# MyTestType

> MyTestType is a Korean cultural entertainment service. Its primary experience is K-Shaman AI Saju, with AI face reading as a secondary experience.

## Public experiences

- [K-Shaman AI Saju](https://mytesttype.com/k-shaman/): Uses birth date and birth time as inputs to present cultural, entertainment-oriented Saju guidance about tendencies and everyday behavior patterns.
- [AI Face Reading](https://mytesttype.com/gwansang/): Uses a submitted photo to present cultural, entertainment-oriented observations about facial features and impressions.

## Scope and safety

- Results are cultural and entertainment-oriented guidance.
- Results do not definitively predict the future or replace medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
- The only public experiences are K-Shaman AI Saju and AI Face Reading.
